data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 晨光白被单的祈愿微笑
data.description: 初升的金辉洒满纯白被褥，伊莉娜跪坐在大床中央。松散的睡衣滑落至腰际，纤巧的锁骨与腰身在晨光下勾勒出极其动人的优美线条。她双手合十闭上双眸做完清晨祈祷，随后睁开眼眸展颜欢笑，笑容比窗外的阳光还要耀眼明媚，向你道出最真挚的早安。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with white ruffled sheets
data.action: kneeling on white bed, pajama top falling off shoulders, hands clasped in morning prayer before opening into a bright radiant smile, sunbeams catching chestnut hair
data.lighting: pure golden dawn rays piercing the bedroom window
data.mood: radiant morning blessing, innocent joy of being together
data.promptProse: Kneeling on a sunlit white bed with her pajama top slipping off bare shoulders, Irina finishes a gentle morning prayer. She looks forward with hands unfolding into a radiant, happy smile bathed in golden dawn light.
data.animaCaption: Irina kneeling on a sunlit bed with bare shoulders, smiling warmly in the morning light.
